verdict.rationale: This axis applies to Homebrew, since a documentation site could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. The probe found docs.brew.sh/llms.txt returns HTTP 404, and nothing in the pack shows agent-oriented docs. The JSON formula API and the manpage are general-purpose resources, not agent-targeted documentation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
